exact_statement: Let f_n(x)=1-2*1{x=0^n} on the uniform n-cube, n>=1, and tau=1-h2(1-1/sqrt(2)). For every zero-error adaptive physical singleton restriction tree computing f_n, with no repeated coordinate on a path, the expected number of queried coordinates is at least 2-2^(1-n), with equality when constant branches stop. Consequently the additive bill tau times expected queried coordinates divided by I(f_n)=2n*2^(-n) is at least tau*(2^n-1)/n>(2^n-1)/(14n), and diverges. This refutes universal influence payment of the unmodified per-query A096 uniform tau bill alone; it does not refute FEI, J<=M on the uniform cube, min{tau,Delta}, or a correctly amortized actual entropy ledger.
